verdict.rationale: Plausible ships a documented funnel-analysis feature that lets users define multi-step sequences (sequential or strict order) to see drop-off, and the dashboard supports filtering/drilling into any traffic slice by clicking report entries. However, the docs do not show combining custom filters or dimension breakdowns *within* a funnel view (e.g., segmenting a funnel by source/device), and one community comment claims the founders have resisted deeper user-flow tracking, suggesting the feature is more basic than a full drop-off/breakdown analysis tool. Missing for 10: evidence of applying filters/breakdowns directly inside funnel reports, and independent hands-on confirmation of funnel depth beyond docs.
